from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
y=dA_dt; V=np.var(y)
f=lambda p: (p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*A**2)*np.sin(p[2]*np.sqrt(t)) + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]/t)/(1+p[5]*A)
             + p[6]*A*np.exp(-p[7]/t) + p[8]*np.sin(p[9]*A))
rng=np.random.default_rng(5)
best=(1e9,None)
for s in range(30):
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, rng.uniform(-3,3,10), max_nfev=200)
        v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/V
        if np.isfinite(v) and v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
    except Exception: pass
print(best[0], np.round(best[1],4).tolist())
